title: Split a beam
summary: Split the beam equally between the Right and Up detectors. You may place one slab of dense glass in the marked region. The split must be 50/50 within 5 percentage points. The score compares each detector's power with the half it should get and counts the smaller of the two.
hints: A slab turned by 45 degrees reflects part of the beam by 90 degrees and lets the rest pass.
Turn the slab so that the reflected light goes up.
How much a thin slab reflects depends on its thickness, because the reflections from its two faces interfere. Try thicknesses between 0.3 and 0.4 micrometres.

goal.text: Split the beam 50/50 between Right and Up
